breakdown.description: NPSH available is based on absolute pressure head at the pump suction; neglecting atmospheric pressure for an open reservoir is inconsistent and underpredicts suction pressure head.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification explicitly states 'neglecting atmospheric pressure' and uses the formula NPSHa = -hs - hL - Pv/(rho g), which omits the p_atm/(rho g) term. The ground truth requires NPSHa = (p_atm/(rho g)) - hs - hL - (Pv/(rho g)) with p_atm = 101.3 kPa. The inconsistency of neglecting atmospheric pressure is not resolved.

breakdown.description: Mixing gauge and absolute pressures in NPSH calculations leads to incorrect cavitation margin.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification still omits atmospheric pressure while including vapor pressure in absolute terms (Pv = 3.2 kPa absolute). This perpetuates the mixing of gauge pressure (0 at reservoir surface) and absolute pressure (Pv), leading to an incorrect cavitation margin. The ground truth resolves this by consistently using absolute pressures including p_atm = 101.3 kPa.
